key_points: Aksha is an intelligent surveillance system designed for automated environment monitoring.
Utilizes advanced technologies such as Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence, and Generative AI.
Aims to minimize human intervention while enhancing security and operational efficiency.
Offers multiple deployment models: Aksha on Edge, Aksha UI & Backend on Edge, and Aksha on Cloud.
Supports hybrid configurations for flexibility in resource management.
Designed for scalability and ease of integration with existing systems.
Real-time object detection and anomaly identification using AI.
Customizable alerts for various scenarios, enhancing user responsiveness.
Generates insightful reports and analytics to support decision-making.
Collaboration with NDIL led to the development of 'Aksha for Workers Safety'.
Implemented a robust Edge + Cloud architecture for enhanced performance.
Continuous improvements through phases, including Gen AI integration for better feature sets.
Clients report significant reductions in human monitoring efforts.
Enhanced ability to detect and respond to abnormal events, improving safety.
Positive feedback on the innovative use of CCTV technology for proactive security measures.
Utilizes Kubernetes for effortless scalability and microservices management.
Real-time data processing capabilities ensure timely insights and actions.
Future developments aim to further enhance Aksha’s features and user experience.
